name: DCx (Dual Contouring over Expanded Cubes)
definition: DCx is an extension of the standard Dual Contouring algorithm designed to extract zero-level sets from neural Unsigned Distance Functions (UDFs). It addresses the lack of sign information in UDFs by using an optimization-based strategy for active cube detection and operating on 2x2x2 voxel blocks (expanded cubes) to support non-manifold structures.
